scientific_integrity: Proof uses the published exact real-ADP slice characterization, an exact complex-rotation identity, and a triangle inequality; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform lower bound only; optimality unknown; no converse, no statement about combinations of slices, and no new claim to qualitative RNP obstruction. Earlier equivalent estimates may exist.
title: Uniform slice-diameter separation for complex realifications with the alternative Daugavet property
